hook: Electric motorcycles expand reach to Hyderabad

Eicher Motors manufactures Royal Enfield and stands to benefit from EV market expansion. Indian retail investors should monitor the company's EV adoption rate against traditional ICE motorcycle sales.

Indian retail investors tracking auto portfolios should note the margin pressure despite strong volume growth.

headline: Jefferies raises Reliance weightage, adds Kotak and Welspun
hook: Jefferies reshuffles its India model portfolio
summary: Jefferies has increased its allocation to Reliance Industries while adding Kotak Mahindra Bank and Welspun Corp to its model portfolio. Simultaneously, the brokerage reduced its exposure to interest-rate-sensitive sectors including NBFCs and real estate. Despite the trimming, Jefferies maintains an 'overweight' stance on these sectors and Eicher Motors. These adjustments reflect shifting sector preferences within the brokerage's investment strategy.
why_it_matters: Brokerage portfolio shifts can influence short-term institutional buying patterns.
winners_losers: Reliance, Kotak, Welspun gain / NBFCs, Real Estate hurt
